rows.description: My parents leave me at home alone and trust me to follow their rules. I feel grown up. Keeping their trust when unobserved makes them give me more freedom.

rows.description: I told a small lie and nobody knows, yet I feel uneasy. Small lies grow bigger if I keep them. Fixing it by telling the truth helps my conscience and my relationships.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: honesty, temptation, trust
related mind states: anxiety

rows.description: A friend dares me to do something naughty while adults are away. I fear looking like a coward. I can say no with a smile or a joke, and true friends will not mind.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: deceit, honesty, temptation, trust
related mind states: fear

rows.description: In a village honesty shop, people pay by leaving money in a box. I feel the weight of being trusted. Being trusted is a gift that I honour by paying the full amount.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: deceit, honesty, temptation
related mind states: trust

rows.description: I see a policeman in uniform and feel respect and slight fear. Police exist to keep people safe; I can learn that I may ask them for help if I am lost or in trouble.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: fear, respect
related mind states: admiration, fear, awe, trust

rows.description: My friends tell scary stories about police and I get nervous. I can ask parents what police really do, and learn that a good officer helps children.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, respect
related mind states: fear, anxiety

rows.description: I learn to stop at red lights and cross at zebra crossings. Rules keep everyone safe, and I remind adults politely if they break them.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, fear
related mind states: admiration, trust

rows.description: An adult in authority is rude or unfair to my family. I feel angry and powerless. I remember that power does not make someone right, and rely on my parents to handle it safely.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, fear, respect
related mind states: anger, trust

rows.description: The guard at our building greets everyone each morning. I greet him back and learn his name. Respecting everyone, whatever their job, is part of being a good citizen.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, fear
related mind states: admiration

rows.description: An adult tells me to keep a secret or do something that feels wrong. I feel torn because I must obey elders. I can say no, leave, and tell a trusted adult; safety comes first.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, fear, respect
